messages:
maria: Heads up — seeing a tail latency spike for svc->svc calls in us-west during GPU batch jobs. Traces point to DNS timeouts from node-local-dns -> CoreDNS. TCP queries succeed, UDP frequently times out. Anyone else? :eyes:

aj: Got the pager. node-local-dns in west shows high retry rates and 'i/o timeout' from forward plugin. Affected services: inference-worker, model-fetcher.

sre-bot: alert: dns_error_rate > 5% cluster-west (5m). Affected pods: model-fetcher-* , inference-worker-*.

noah: took a pcap from one pod -> node path. Seeing UDP fragments, then ICMP "frag needed" with MTU 9000 reported. Example tcpdump output: `IP 10.0.2.34.53 > 10.0.5.12.51432: UDP, length 1420` followed by fragments.

arjun: That smells like MTU mismatch + RDMA NIC offload (Mellanox). If jumbo on some hops but overlay clamps to 1500 you'll get fragmentation + ICMP. CoreDNS UDP doesn't retry well in our forward path. Also check conntrack pressure for node-local-dns (hostNetwork ds).

maria: tcpdump snippet pasted from node-local capture:
```
15:23:01.123456 IP 10.0.2.34.53 > 10.0.5.12.51432: UDP, length 1420
15:23:01.123457 IP (frag 1/2) 10.0.2.34.53 > 10.0.5.12.51432: UDP, length 1420
15:23:01.123458 IP (frag 2/2) 10.0.2.34.53 > 10.0.5.12.51432: UDP, length 200
15:23:01.123460 ICMP 10.0.5.12 > 10.0.2.34: frag needed and DF set, mtu 1500
```

aj: Confirmed. Data-plane uses jumbo MTU (9000) but some overlay path clamps to 1500 causing fragments. That leads to UDP DNS packet loss/timeouts.

noah: Additional signal: node-local-dns logs show spike in cache evictions during the window: "cache evictions=1200 miss_rate x8" — probably thousands of short-lived model pods hammering resolution.

arjun: Quick mitigation plan: 1) enable TCP fallback / increase tcp timeouts for CoreDNS forward, 2) limit EDNS UDP size to ~1232 to avoid fragmentation, 3) scale node-local-dns replicas temporarily, 4) apply MTU clamp (MSS clamping) on affected nodes as a canary.

maria: I'll run the canary: add iptables rule to clamp MSS and set veth mtu to 1500 on 3 GPU nodes in west. Rolling now. Will also scale node-local-dns DS 1->3 for that pool.

sre-bot: action created: INC-2026 | dns-west-mtu-clamp | assigned: aj | severity: P2

aj: Can confirm canary on gpu-west-a/b/c: DNS UDP timeouts dropped from ~6% -> 0.6% within 3m after MSS clamp + node-local-dns x3. :thumbsup:

noah: Long-term: we should standardize MTU across RDMA-enabled nics + overlay (calico/ipip/eni), and disable GRO/TSO on DNS-hosting nodes as needed. Also explore making node-local-dns forwarders prefer TCP for larger responses.

arjun: I pushed a CoreDNS staging tweak: forward plugin with `max_concurrent 1000` and edns0 size lowered to `1232`. Staging tests passed for fragmentation cases.

maria: Thanks all — will keep the canary for 2 hours, collect pod pcaps, and open infra change for MTU sweep + RDMA config. Filing a ticket to coordinate with infra team.

aj: ping @infra-team when you have the ticket. Good job narrowing root cause quickly.

maria: will do. scheduling follow-up retrospective tomorrow. :coffee:
